name: tool-discipline-lsp
description: LSP navigation guardrails: a PreToolUse hook that pushes Go/TS symbol searches (grep/rg or the Grep tool) toward the LSP tool, plus a PostToolUse advisory that nudges a retry/pivot when workspaceSymbol returns empty (often just a cold index, not an absent symbol). Fail-open: inert unless ENABLE_LSP_TOOL=1 and the backing server binary is present
